title: Tensions and Diplomacy: Navigating the Strait of Hormuz Crisis
description: The crisis in the Strait of Hormuz highlights escalating tensions between the U.S. and Iran, impacting global oil prices. While the U.S. pauses military escorts for ships amid talks, Iran denies any crossings have taken place. Diplomatic efforts continue, with Pakistan mediating and Trump set to visit China.

title: Ahead of Trump-Xi summit, Rubio urges China to help open Strait of Hormuz
description: White House officials are renewing calls on China to use its influence with Iran to open the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Trump advisers step up their calls on China to help open Strait of Hormuz ahead of Beijing summit
description: White House officials are renewing calls on China to use its influence with Iran to open the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Trump Advisers Step up Their Calls on China to Help Open Strait of Hormuz Ahead of Beijing Summit
description: WASHINGTON (AP) — White House officials are pressing China to use its influence with Iran to open the Strait of Hormuz just days before President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping'shighly anticipated summit in Beijing.

title: Commentary: Could an energy crisis get Philippines and China to cooperate in South China Sea?
description: In its desperation to secure oil supplies amid the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, the Philippines has turned to countries with which it has strained relations, says this academic.

title: New UN Resolution: A Test for Global Diplomacy
description: The US and Gulf allies have proposed a UN resolution to sanction Iran if it doesn't stop ship attacks and tolls in the Strait of Hormuz. The move aims to ensure navigation freedom and establish a humanitarian corridor. The diplomatic effort faces challenges, with potential vetoes from China and Russia.

title: Rubio warns against Taiwan escalation, urges China to pressure Iran ahead of Trump visit
description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Washington and Beijing share an interest in avoiding escalation over Taiwan, warning that neither side benefits from any destabilising developments in the region.

title: Taiwan and the Diplomatic Tightrope: Trump, Xi, and Regional Stability
description: U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are expected to discuss Taiwan during their upcoming meeting. Secretary of State Marco Rubio emphasized the importance of avoiding instability regarding Taiwan, which is under growing military pressure from China. The U.S. remains a key ally and arms supplier for Taiwan.

title: Trump says China, Xi Jinping are not challenging the US on Iran
description: President Donald Trump says the U.S. hasn't been challenged by China on Iran, describing leader Xi Jinping as "very respectful" amid tensions over the Strait of Hormuz.
